paragraphs.en: My agent skills that I use every day to do real engineering - not vibe coding.
paragraphs.zh: 我每天用来做真正工程工作的智能体技能——而不是凭感觉随意写代码（vibe coding）。

paragraphs.en: Developing real applications is hard. Approaches like GSD, BMAD, and Spec-Kit try to help by owning the process. But while doing so, they take away your control and make bugs in the process hard to resolve.
paragraphs.zh: 开发真实的应用程序很难。 像 GSD、BMAD 和 Spec-Kit 这样的方法试图通过接管整个流程来提供帮助。 但这样做的同时，它们剥夺了你的控制权，并使流程中的 bug 难以解决。

paragraphs.en: These skills are designed to be small, easy to adapt, and composable. They work with any model. They're based on decades of engineering experience. Hack around with them. Make them your own. Enjoy.
paragraphs.zh: 这些技能的设计目标是小巧、易于改编且可组合。 它们适用于任何模型。 它们基于数十年的工程经验。随意改造它们，让它们成为你自己的东西，并享受其中的乐趣。

paragraphs.en: A plugin updates itself. skills.sh copies editable files into your project, and you update them by hand. Pick one per agent, because installing both gives you every skill twice.
paragraphs.zh: 插件会自行更新。skills.sh 会将可编辑的文件复制到你的项目中，由你手动更新。 每个智能体只能选一种，因为同时安装两者会让你获得重复的每个技能。

paragraphs.en: I built these skills as a way to fix common failure modes I see with Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我构建这些技能，是为了解决我在使用 Claude Code、Codex 和其他编码智能体时看到的常见失败模式。

paragraphs.en: David Thomas & Andrew Hunt, The Pragmatic Programmer
paragraphs.zh: David Thomas & Andrew Hunt，《程序员修炼之道》（The Pragmatic Programmer）

paragraphs.en: The Problem . The most common failure mode in software development is misalignment. You think the dev knows what you want. Then you see what they've built - and you realize it didn't understand you at all.
paragraphs.zh: 问题所在。 软件开发中最常见的失败模式是对齐偏差。 你以为开发者知道你想要什么。 然后当你看到他们构建出来的东西时——你才意识到它完全没有理解你。

sents.en: The Problem .
sents.zh: 问题所在。

sents.en: The most common failure mode in software development is misalignment.
sents.zh: 软件开发中最常见的失败模式是对齐偏差。

sents.en: You think the dev knows what you want.
sents.zh: 你以为开发者知道你想要什么。

sents.en: Then you see what they've built - and you realize it didn't understand you at all.
sents.zh: 然后当你看到他们构建出来的东西时——你才意识到它完全没有理解你。

paragraphs.en: This is just the same in the AI age. There is a communication gap between you and the agent. The fix for this is a grilling session - getting the agent to ask you detailed questions about what you're building.
paragraphs.zh: 在人工智能时代，情况也是如此。 你和智能体之间存在沟通鸿沟。 解决这个问题的方法是进行一场追问式沟通——让智能体就你正在构建的东西向你提出详细的问题。

paragraphs.en: These are my most popular skills. They help you align with the agent before you get started, and think deeply about the change you're making. Use them every time you want to make a change.

paragraphs.en: With a ubiquitous language, conversations among developers and expressions of the code are all derived from the same domain model.
paragraphs.zh: 有了统一语言，开发者之间的对话和代码的表达都源自同一个领域模型。

paragraphs.en: The Problem : At the start of a project, devs and the people they're building the software for (the domain experts) are usually speaking different languages.
paragraphs.zh: 问题所在：在项目开始时，开发人员与他们为之构建软件的对象（即领域专家）通常说着不同的语言。

paragraphs.en: I felt the same tension with my agents. Agents are usually dropped into a project and asked to figure out the jargon as they go. So they use 20 words where 1 will do.
paragraphs.zh: 我在使用智能体时也感受到了同样的张力。 智能体通常被直接投入一个项目，并被要求在过程中自行摸索其中的行话。 于是它们明明 1 个词就够，却用了 20 个词。

paragraphs.en: A shared language has many other benefits than reducing verbosity:
paragraphs.zh: 共享语言除了减少冗长之外还有许多其他好处：

paragraphs.en: "Always take small, deliberate steps. The rate of feedback is your speed limit. Never take on a task that’s too big."
paragraphs.zh: 始终采取小而审慎的步骤。 反馈的速度就是你的限速。 永远不要承接过大的任务。

paragraphs.en: The Problem : Let's say that you and the agent are aligned on what to build. What happens when the agent still produces crap?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：假设你和智能体已经就构建什么达成了一致。 那么当智能体仍然产出垃圾时会发生什么？

sents.en: The Problem : Let's say that you and the agent are aligned on what to build.
sents.zh: 问题：假设你和智能体已经就构建什么达成了一致。

sents.en: What happens when the agent still produces crap?
sents.zh: 那么当智能体仍然产出垃圾时会发生什么？

paragraphs.en: It's time to look at your feedback loops. Without feedback on how the code it produces actually runs, the agent will be flying blind.
paragraphs.zh: 是时候审视你的反馈回路了。 如果没有关于代码实际运行情况的反馈，智能体就会像盲飞一样行动。

sents.en: It's time to look at your feedback loops.
sents.zh: 是时候审视你的反馈回路了。

sents.en: Without feedback on how the code it produces actually runs, the agent will be flying blind.
sents.zh: 如果没有关于代码实际运行情况的反馈，智能体就会像盲飞一样行动。

paragraphs.en: The Fix : You need the usual tranche of feedback loops: static types, browser access, and automated tests.
paragraphs.zh: 修复方法：你需要常用的那套反馈循环：静态类型、浏览器访问和自动化测试。

paragraphs.en: For automated tests, a red-green-refactor loop is critical. This is where the agent writes a failing test first, then fixes the test. This helps give the agent a consistent level of feedback that results in far better code.
paragraphs.zh: 对于自动化测试来说，「红-绿-重构」循环至关重要。 在这种做法中，智能体会先编写一个失败的测试，然后再修复该测试。 这有助于给智能体提供一致的反馈水平，从而产出质量高得多的代码。

paragraphs.en: I've built a /tdd skill you can slot into any project. It encourages red-green-refactor and gives the agent plenty of guidance on what makes good and bad tests.
paragraphs.zh: 我构建了一个 /tdd 技能，你可以把它插入任何项目中使用。 它鼓励红-绿-重构（red-green-refactor）的工作流程，并为智能体提供大量指导，说明什么样的测试是好的、什么样的测试是不好的。

paragraphs.en: For debugging, I've also built a /diagnosing-bugs skill that wraps best debugging practices into a disciplined loop, gated phase by phase.
paragraphs.zh: 为了调试，我还构建了一个 /diagnosing-bugs 技能，它将最佳调试实践封装成一个有纪律的循环，并逐阶段进行把关。

paragraphs.en: "Invest in the design of the system every day ."
paragraphs.zh: “每天投入精力进行系统设计。”

paragraphs.en: Kent Beck, Extreme Programming Explained
paragraphs.zh: Kent Beck，《解析极限编程》（Extreme Programming Explained）

paragraphs.en: "The best modules are deep. They allow a lot of functionality to be accessed through a simple interface."
paragraphs.zh: 最好的模块是深模块。 它们允许通过简单的接口访问大量的功能。

paragraphs.en: John Ousterhout, A Philosophy Of Software Design
paragraphs.zh: John Ousterhout，《软件设计哲学》

paragraphs.en: The Problem : Most apps built with agents are complex and hard to change. Because agents can radically speed up coding, they also accelerate software entropy. Codebases get more complex at an unprecedented rate.
paragraphs.zh: 问题所在：大多数使用智能体构建的应用程序都很复杂且难以修改。 由于智能体能极大加快编码速度，它们也会加速软件的熵增。 代码库正以前所未有的速度变得更加复杂。

paragraphs.en: The Fix for this is a radical new approach to AI-powered development: caring about the design of the code.
paragraphs.zh: 解决这个问题的方法是一种全新的AI驱动开发方式：关注代码的设计。

paragraphs.en: And crucially, /improve-codebase-architecture surveys a codebase for deepening opportunities and hands you the candidates. I recommend running it on your codebase once every few days. It is a survey, not a rescue: on a genuinely old codebase it will find real candidates, but it won't untangle the mud for you.
paragraphs.zh: 而且关键的是，/improve-codebase-architecture 会扫描代码库以寻找深化改进的机会，并把这些候选方案交给你。 我建议每隔几天在你的代码库上运行一次。 它是一项调查，而不是一次拯救：在一个真正老旧的代码库上，它会找到真实的候选方案，但它不会替你解开那团泥潭。

sents.en: These skills are my best effort at condensing these fundamentals into repeatable practices, to help you ship the best apps of your career. Enjoy.
sents.zh: 这些技能是我将这些基本原则凝练为可复用实践的最佳努力，帮助你发布职业生涯中最出色的应用。祝愉快。

paragraphs.en: These split on one axis: who can invoke them. User-invoked skills are reachable only when you type them (e.g. /grill-me ); their job is to orchestrate. Model-invoked skills can be invoked by you or reached for automatically by the agent when the task fits; they hold the reusable discipline. A user-invoked skill may invoke model-invoked skills, but never another user-invoked one.
paragraphs.zh: 它们在一个维度上有所区分：谁可以调用它们。 用户调用的技能只有在你输入时才会被触达（例如 /grill-me）；它们的职责是编排。 模型调用的技能既可以由你调用，也可以在任务合适时被智能体自动触达；它们承载可复用的规范。 用户调用的技能可以调用模型调用的技能，但绝不能调用另一个用户调用的技能。
